title: Politieke democratie en welzijn 1974-1977
contributors: Vakgroep nationale politieke systemen, instituut voor politicologie * Nijmegen
descriptions: Effects of democratic quality of a state on welfare policy and level, controlling for level of economic development. Political indicators, a.o freedom of press, freedom of group opposition / role of police and army / independent jurisdiction / electoral system / social indicators, a.o. life expectancy / violence / inequality of income / political prisoners / number of G.P.s per 1 million inhabitants.
